resources.string: Brings the home screen back when the built-in launcher takes over. Only checks which app is in front; it does not read screen content.

Android 12 and newer, off by default, and it needs the home guard. Every key then passes through the guard, so some apps may move twice for one press. It does not turn on for Xiaomi. Turn it off to go back to the usual filter.
Choose 5 or 6 icons in the Dock. The app grid uses the same column count. Applies when you return Home.
Android reports Tigris as Home. Open another app, press the physical Home button, then test reboot and standby. These checks are not automatically verified.
Home Guard appears connected, but this is not native HOME. Test the physical Home key, reboot, wake, and memory cleanup. If it fails, use the model-specific guide.
Xiaomi / Redmi: MIUI or HyperOS may force PatchWall and stop Tigris on standby. Do not disable PatchWall or Settings. Follow firmware-specific HOME diagnostics and authorized Guard setup.
TCL / FFalcon: some firmwares reject Standard APK or block Guard autostart. Check the verifier result and ADB authorization. Guard installation via T-Cast may require TV confirmation.
Tigris is not the detected HOME and the required Guard permission is missing. Follow your TV model’s authorized ADB or manual setup instructions.
This firmware does not currently report Tigris as native HOME or a connected Guard. Use the official installation guide and a read-only device diagnosis first.
Automatically composed brand artwork or original frost-grey cards; applies when returning Home
Compare Apple tvOS 5:3 and Android TV 16:9 with actual layouts
Open an app card to return. Android does not expose tvOS task previews to third-party launchers.
No recent apps yet. Open an app from Tigris first.

Separate local launcher order, hidden apps and recent-first setting. Not an Android or Apple ID account.
Opens the TV original system settings; support depends on firmware and permissions.
